title: biopalette
text: biopalette 是一个 R 包，提供图像启发的配色方案，专为生物医学可视化设计。 每一套配色都源自一张真实的图像——电影剧照、科研图表或艺术作品——并转化为可复现的色彩系统。来源始终有据可查：颜色从哪里来、代表什么、适合用在哪里。
code: library(biopalette)  get_palette("babel", n = 5) get_palette("three_body") get_palette("walter_white", type = "diverging")  preview_palette("gene_red") palette_gallery()  # ggplot2 离散与连续尺度 scale_color_biopalette("three_body") scale_fill_biopalette_gradient("mitonuclear_blue")

title: Palettes included in biopalette
text: Qualitative palettes distinguish unordered categories. first n colors returned smaller set requested, every stored color curated category color rather stop continuous ramp.  Choose palette size match real number groups: gene_red heat_light provide restrained two-group contrasts; three_body provides three strongly separated colors; walter_white2, lactate_steps, tam_pastel cover common medium-sized groupings; cancer_mosaic babel support unusually large categorical displays. Added heat_light — qualitative, 2 colors, bond ampholysis illustration (Nature, 2024). Added tam_pastel — qualitative, 6 colors, pan-cancer myeloid atlas (Cell, 2021). Added cancer_mosaic — qualitative, 15 colors, pan-cancer myeloid atlas (Cell, 2021). Added lactate_steps — qualitative, 5 colors, lactate metabolism immunotherapy research (JECCR, 2024). Added source images, curation records, previews, showcase figures new palettes.
